0: City of Santa Claus, Georgia Ordinance (Business License Rates) The Council of the City of Santa Claus hereby ordains; 1. The ordinance adopted June 6, 1985 repealing all business license rates in the City except those for the Santa Claus Grocery shall be repealed in its entirety. 2. That all business license rates shall be fully reinstated as were before the adoption of said ordinance of June 6, 1985. 3. That rates for business license shall be charged as per the attached schedule.
